# Snowflake Cortex

Use `snowflake-cortex/<model>` with VoltAgent's model router.

## Quick start

```ts
import { Agent } from "@voltagent/core";

const agent = new Agent({
  name: "snowflake-cortex-agent",
  instructions: "You are a helpful assistant",
  model: "snowflake-cortex/claude-fable-5",
});
```

## Environment variables

- `SNOWFLAKE_ACCOUNT`
- `SNOWFLAKE_CORTEX_PAT`

## Provider package

`@ai-sdk/openai-compatible`

This provider uses the OpenAI-compatible adapter.

## Default base URL

`https://${SNOWFLAKE_ACCOUNT}.snowflakecomputing.com/api/v2/cortex/v1`

You can override the base URL by setting `SNOWFLAKE_CORTEX_BASE_URL`.

## Provider docs

- https://docs.snowflake.com/en/user-guide/snowflake-cortex/cortex-rest-api
